title: porter rule candidate
description: One manual or agent fix, logged as a candidate for a rule. Logs are JSON Lines (*.candidates.jsonl): one candidate per line, each line validated on its own. loop aggregates by 'normalized'; count >= 3 produces a draft rule in rules/_proposed/.

id.description: Stable id; loop assigns sha-based ids.

error.description: Compiler error message as reported (javac text).

file.description: Source file relative to the project root.

before.description: Code before the fix (statement or minimal snippet).

symbol.description: Symbol involved, 'Owner#name(Params)' or a class FQN, in the 'from' version when known.

normalized.description: Normalized form used for aggregation (identifiers abstracted to placeholders).

author.description: Who made the fix: agent:<name>, human:<name> or rule:<rule-id> (the latter for audit only).

ruleId.description: Rule drafted/accepted from this candidate, once it exists.
